title: Universal Rule Schema v8.0
description: Machine-readable rule structure with dual identity, evaluation logic, lineage tracking, and finding FSM.

x-cross-layer-binding.rule: SPECIFICATION.md is the normative source. Schema is a structural projection of spec invariants. Policy describes governance intent only.

x-identity-resolution.policy_mapping: Machine ID in directive tables maps to rule.lineage_id
x-identity-resolution.spec_mapping: node.lineage_id in CG-IR maps to rule.lineage_id; node.directive_id maps to rule.id
x-identity-resolution.rule: Dual identity: lineage_id (immutable root) + id (active execution identity). lineage_id never changes; id changes on fork/merge/split.

operations.revision: Same lineage_id, same execution_id, new revision.
operations.fork: Same lineage_id inherited, two new execution_ids.
operations.merge: Two lineage_ids merged, one new execution_id.
operations.split: Same lineage_id inherited, multiple new execution_ids.

x-identity-lifecycle.rule: lineage_id is immutable once assigned. execution_id changes only on fork/merge/split.

x-identity-resolution.policy_mapping: Machine ID in directive tables maps to rule.id
x-identity-resolution.spec_mapping: directive_id in CG-IR nodes maps to rule.id
x-identity-resolution.rule: One canonical identifier per directive across all layers.

operations.revision: Same ID, new revision. Changes within same semantic intent. lineage field NOT required.
operations.fork: Two new IDs. One directive splits into two distinct directives. lineage field REQUIRED.
operations.merge: One new ID. Two directives combine into one. lineage field REQUIRED.
operations.split: New IDs for each. One directive restructured into multiple. lineage field REQUIRED.
operations.rename: Same ID. Display name changes, semantic intent unchanged. lineage field NOT required.
operations.retire: Same ID, status=deprecated. Never reused. lineage field NOT required.

x-identity-lifecycle.rule: Once assigned, a Machine ID is never reused. Deprecated IDs remain in audit trail forever.
x-identity-lifecycle.uniqueness_enforcement: rule.id MUST be unique within a ruleset. Pattern: ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*$

x-deterministic-serialization.number_encoding: integer as integer, float as IEEE 754 double
x-deterministic-serialization.canonical_form: All objects serialized with sorted keys before hashing
x-deterministic-serialization.recursive_structures: For recursive evaluator_config: serialize sub_evaluators as array of canonical JSON objects. For lineage: serialize parent_ids as sorted array.
x-deterministic-serialization.schema_references: $ref resolved at schema validation time; not included in canonical form for hashing

x-conflict-resolution-binding.spec_model: Deterministic multi-factor: priority → specificity → recency → explicit override
x-conflict-resolution-binding.schema_model: conflict_resolution field provides explicit override only
x-conflict-resolution-binding.precedence: Explicit override (conflict_resolution field) takes precedence over computed resolution. If no conflict_resolution field, spec multi-factor algorithm applies.
x-conflict-resolution-binding.policy_model: Declarative intent description only. Compilation engine implements via spec multi-factor algorithm.

version.description: Semantic version of this rule dataset. MUST match spec version for compatibility.

policy_contract_version.description: Version of the paired policy_doctrine.yaml. MUST match policy version.

policy_contract_id.description: Identifier of the paired policy contract.

metadata.description: Open container for context (jurisdiction, domain, project).

rules.description: The list of directives. Every rule MUST have a unique lineage_id and id.

lineage_id.description: Immutable root identifier. Assigned once, never reused. Used for audit trail.

id.description: Active execution identifier. May change on fork/merge/split. Used for CG-IR compilation.

target.description: Who or what this rule applies to.

anchor_ref.description: Link back to the human document section.

evaluator_type.description: Pure evaluator type. Discriminator for evaluator_config.

depends_on.description: IDs of rules that must be evaluated first.

conflicts_with.description: IDs of rules that cannot coexist.

conflict_resolution.description: Explicit conflict resolution override. Takes precedence over computed resolution.

defer_to.description: Rule ID to defer to (required if strategy=defer_to)

lineage.description: Tracks identity lifecycle operations. REQUIRED for fork, merge, split. NOT required for revision, rename, retire.

parent_lineage_ids.description: Immutable root IDs of parent directives

parent_execution_ids.description: Active execution IDs of parent directives at time of operation

evaluator_config_entry.description: A single sub-evaluator entry within a composite evaluator.

evaluator_config.description: Configuration for this sub-evaluator (same schema as top-level evaluator_config for the given type).
